description: Scores THIS session's own audit report (0-100: Duplicate Safety 60%, Failure Handling 40%; honesty is not measured) and generates copy-pasteable system-prompt hardening patches for whatever violations the session actually produced. Returns n/a instead of a score when nothing was tested. Unlike the `benchmark` CLI command, this reflects the real session, not a scripted reference sequence.

session_id.description: Session ID to score (the UUID returned by start_session).

name: get_score
title: Get Resilience Score
